## Question 1: For the relation represented by all of the columns in the CSV file and the table in the SQLite database, define all functional dependencies and list them.

### Tables
$$
\begin{aligned}
\texttt{servers.rid} &\to \texttt{restaurants.rid}\\
\texttt{visits.billid} &\to \texttt{bill.billid}\\
\texttt{bill.pmid} &\to \texttt{paymentmethods.pmid}\\
\texttt{visits.serverempid} &\to \texttt{servers.empid}\\
\texttt{visits.restaurantid} &\to \texttt{restaurants.rid}\\
\texttt{visits.mtid} &\to \texttt{mealtypes.mtid}\\
\texttt{visits.customerid} &\to \texttt{customers.cid}\\
\end{aligned}
$$

### restaurants 
$$
\begin{aligned}
\texttt{restaurants.rid} &\to \texttt{restaurants.restaurantname}\\
\texttt{restaurants.rid} &\to \texttt{restaurants.city}\\
\texttt{restaurants.rid} &\to \texttt{restaurants.state}\\
\texttt{restaurants.rid} &\to \texttt{restaurants.hastableservice}\\
\end{aligned}
$$

### servers 
$$
\begin{aligned}
\texttt{empid} &\to \texttt{servername},\ \texttt{startdatehired},\ \texttt{enddatehired},\ \texttt{hourlyrate}\\
\texttt{empid} &\to \texttt{birthdate},\ \texttt{ssn},\ \texttt{rid}
\end{aligned}
$$

### customers
$$
\begin{aligned}
\texttt{customers.cid} &\to \texttt{customers.customername},\ \texttt{customers.customerphone},\ \texttt{customers.customeremail},\ \texttt{customers.loyaltymember}\\
\end{aligned}
$$

### visits 
$$
\begin{aligned}
\texttt{visits.visitid} &\to \texttt{visits.visittime},\ 
\texttt{visits.billid}\\
\texttt{visits.visitid} &\to \texttt{visits.serverempid}\\
\texttt{visits.visitid} &\to \texttt{visits.restaurantid},\ 
\texttt{visits.customerid}\\
\texttt{visits.visitid} &\to \texttt{visits.waittime},\ 
\texttt{visits.mtid}\\
\texttt{visits.visitid} &\to \texttt{visits.visitdate},\ 
\texttt{visits.partysize}\\
\end{aligned}
$$

### bill
$$
\begin{aligned}
\texttt{bill.billid} &\to \texttt{bill.foodbill}\\
\texttt{bill.billid} &\to \texttt{bill.tipamount},\ 
\texttt{bill.fooddiscountpercentage}\\
\texttt{bill.billid} &\to \texttt{bill.pmid},\ \texttt{bill.orderedalcohol},\ 
\texttt{bill.alcoholbill}\\
\end{aligned}
$$

### paymentmethods
$$
\begin{aligned}
\texttt{paymentmethods.pmid} &\to 
\texttt{paymentmethods.paymentmethod}\\
\end{aligned}
$$

### mealtypes 
$$
\begin{aligned}
\texttt{mealtypes.mtid} &\to \texttt{mealtypes.mealtype}\\
\end{aligned}
$$

</br>
